risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, including year-over-year revenue, expense, margin, tax, and inventory information. It includes meaningful risk discussion around COVID-19, customer concentration/exposure, government spending, supply disruptions, and inventory obsolescence, although some forward-looking statements rely on broad conditional language. Operating results improved modestly, but reduced cash balances, lower interest income, and demand uncertainty temper the otherwise mildly favorable tone.
